purpose: Keep the 2025 CKM population stock as the forecast base while preserving pre-CKM calibration through 2024.
requiredChecks: calibration preCkmEnd is 2024 and ckmStart is 2025
all five municipalities have complete age/sex base population rows for 2025
FA base population equals the sum of its five municipalities
2025 CKM observations remain diagnostics/control data and are not silently appended to pre-CKM calibration windows
the CKM method break and uncertainty delta remain explicit in model metadata
governance: A future base-year rollover must update the bridge explicitly rather than extending calibration across a method break by accident.
The CKM base stock can be updated independently of the historical calibration series.
Any change to the method-break treatment requires a new validation run.
